description: Extends config:recommended; adds this repo's specifics: github.com/werf/nelm follows nelm's trdl STABLE channel (not the Go proxy's latest, which is effectively alpha), k8s.io/* move only in lockstep with nelm, and custom-manager go.mod bumps run `go mod tidy`.

customManagers.description: Bump github.com/werf/nelm in go.mod to whatever version nelm's STABLE trdl channel points to

packageRules.description: gomod manager must NOT touch nelm (the proxy's latest is the alpha channel; the custom manager above owns it) nor the k8s.io modules (transitively pinned by nelm, lockstep-only)
A stable-channel nelm bump edits go.mod outside the gomod artifact updater, so regenerate go.sum; the PR still needs a human semantic review against docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md — never automerge
